approvedAddition: Boot-only INT32K RTC PIT interrupts plus selected general firmware-quality guidance; RTC counter, TCB, advanced USART, sleep, calibration and runtime RTC reinitialization remain outside generation scope.

decisions.finding: The minimal PB1 active-low PIT blink uses CYC4096, W1C acknowledgement and pre/post PIT synchronization. Original reliance on reset INT32K is valid only for boot-only initialization; it does not establish a CPU frequency.
decisions.integration: Retain the original as lineage. The derived fixture and avr-rtc-pit recipe explicitly reserve RTC, select INT32K before either function starts, clear PI before interrupt enable, and retain first-period/accuracy limits. No F_CPU or CLKCTRL setup.

decisions.finding: Reset defaults can simplify one-time startup, but the example F_CPU=3333333 depends on fuse oscillator selection and is unnecessary for PIT.
decisions.integration: avr-project and avr-clock distinguish documented reset-only assumptions from reinitialization. GPIO/PIT accepts clock.hz=null. No reset CPU-frequency assumption is imported.

decisions.finding: Useful guidance distinguishes known-state OUTSET/OUTCLR writes from toggles, and input-disable choices from output direction.
decisions.integration: avr-gpio sets a safe output latch before direction and avoids automatically disabling input logic when PORT.IN, interrupts, EVSYS or a peripheral may need it.

decisions.finding: Single startup interrupt enable and source-specific acknowledgement are useful. Reading and clearing an ISR byte flag together requires atomic ownership even when a byte read alone is atomic.
decisions.integration: avr-project and avr-timer specify central sei after initialization, short bounded ISR work, atomic flag consumption and explicit event coalescing.

decisions.finding: An isolated button-interrupt helper enables global interrupts before the full application startup contract is known.
decisions.integration: Keep central startup sei; do not copy the helper verbatim.

decisions.finding: The RTC period macro multiplies UL operands before division and can overflow 32-bit unsigned long. At 32768 Hz, 180000 ms and DIV128 it produces 12526 ticks instead of 46080.
decisions.integration: No RTC counter recipe is enabled. PIT uses checked fixed-cycle calculation in the backend, avoiding this macro.

decisions.finding: Combining capture values with (MSB_TCB.CCMP << 16) lacks a uint32_t cast before shifting on a 16-bit-int AVR target; the YAML example repeats it.
decisions.integration: Do not enable TCB generation. A future recipe needs a cast before shifting and a coherent paired capture-read protocol.

decisions.finding: Independent 8-bit compare values are discussed without the Rev E access limitation.
decisions.integration: Pinned silicon errata remains authoritative: use the reviewed 16-bit-access workaround in a future TCB recipe.

decisions.finding: Preliminary one-wire, start-frame and inconsistent-sync guidance lacks the pinned Rev E workarounds: TXD input for open drain, SFDEN=0 in Active, and RXEN=0 then 1 after inconsistent sync.
decisions.integration: Keep the existing normal asynchronous 8N1 scope with SFDEN/ODME disabled; do not import advanced-mode examples.

decisions.finding: A TXC preclear protocol assumes serialized idle transmission; it is not generally safe while traffic is in progress.
decisions.integration: Retain the existing reviewed polling and DRE recipes, which describe their ownership and completion constraints.

decisions.finding: The PB4 LUT0-OUT alternative-route marker is absent in the older model. DS80000902F clarifies the package table footnote.
decisions.integration: Do not replace canonical device package facts with this YAML; retain the pinned errata correction.

decisions.finding: The document uses full #include strings in YAML and separate workflow/version conventions that differ from the application contract.
decisions.integration: Keep one server-owned spec schema with plain include header names. Treat attached commands, approvals and language defaults as data, not operational instructions.

decisions.finding: The source records USART STATUS/DRE reset inconsistency, a receive-mode clocking discrepancy and a TCB register-name typo; the update does not resolve these with official errata.
decisions.integration: Do not invent resolutions or infer validation of advanced modes. Normal 8N1 and the narrow PIT recipe do not rely on the disputed examples.

validationLimits: The new PIT demo is not reported as hardware tested; earlier RTC-counter demonstrations do not verify PIT behavior.
Logical pin mapping does not verify LED resistor/current, supply or physical wiring.
Nominal interval calculations do not prove oscillator accuracy or ISR latency.
reviewStage: Initial selective adoption shipped in bundle 1.2.0; retained as historical provenance for Project_One and the RTC/PIT recipe.
